Open Prices.terms: ODbL, as the data.gouv.fr listing states it: any use, if we credit Open Prices and share changes to the dataset. Official licence page not read.
Open Prices.obtained: Community records from prices.openfoodfacts.org. Some record shelf prices at Walmart, Target and Aldi stores, and no store's site was read for them.

which.co.uk.terms: R3 read the terms and found no clause. Usable for reference only, and most scores are locked to members.
which.co.uk.obtained: Prices and scores published in Which? tests.

aponeo.de.terms: Robots, AGB and imprint read 7 Nov. No clause on reuse or automated access. The imprint says only that the content is protected by copyright.
aponeo.de.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

alternate.de.terms: Robots, AGB and imprint read 7 Nov. No clause on reuse or automated access.
alternate.de.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

7dayshop.com.terms: R3 read the terms and found no clause. A scout on 7 Nov couldn't find the page again.
7dayshop.com.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

zooplus.ie.terms: Imprint: "The use of automatic mechanisms (such as search engines, robots and crawlers) in product services or price search engines is also subject to licensing", and storage in databases is prohibited without consent.
zooplus.ie.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool, 7 Nov. Read before the imprint was.

zooplus.de.terms: Imprint: "Die Verwendung automatischer Mechanismen (Suchmaschinen, Robots, Crawler), beispielsweise zur Bedienung von Produkt- oder Preissuchmaschinen, ist ebenso genehmigungspflichtig". R3 read only the sales terms.
zooplus.de.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

walmart.com.terms: R2: bars spiders and robots, through a summary. On 7 Nov the terms page showed a bot check.
walmart.com.obtained: Records quote "Walmart's listing", so a person or tool read the store's page. The first build on 2 Nov already had them, and R2's rejection is from 6 Nov. Later rounds may have added more.

target.com.terms: "Make any use of data extraction, scraping, mining or other data gathering tools" and "Make any commercial use of the Site or its Content, including making any collection or use of any product listings".
target.com.obtained: Store's pages, except where a record cites Open Prices.

costco.com.terms: Section 9: "Use any data mining, robots, agents or similar data gathering or extraction methods designed to scrape".

chewy.com.terms: No copying or republishing, and no commercial exploitation without written consent. Summary was cut short.

shop-apotheke.com.terms: "Der Einsatz von Data Mining, Robots, Grabbing, Scraping und/oder ähnlichen Datensammel- und Extraktionsprogrammen" counts as unauthorised access (apotheke_haftung §7). A scout fetched 5 product pages on 7 Nov after reading this, and discarded them.
shop-apotheke.com.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

rossmann.de.terms: R3: robots bar ClaudeBot. Terms page wouldn't load on 7 Nov.

ikea.com.terms: "None of the content of our website may be copied or otherwise incorporated into or stored in any other web site" (Irish terms, one UK record).

crocus.co.uk.terms: "None of this material may be used without our written permission." Doesn't name prices or automated access. The owner has this one.
crocus.co.uk.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

pollin.de.terms: Imprint: "Die Weiterverwendung des Bild- und Textmaterials ist untersagt." Doesn't name prices or automated access. Robots bar its own AGB and imprint pages.
pollin.de.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

mytime.de.terms: R3 found no clause in the AGB and classed it UNCLEAR. Imprint not read. Robots bar ?page=, ?sort= and ?category=.
mytime.de.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

dehner.de.terms: AGB has no clause, as a scout read it. Imprint not read.
dehner.de.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

viking-direct.co.uk.terms: R3: no clause in the readable part, and the PDF was partly unreadable.
viking-direct.co.uk.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool. Some may be out of date.

uline.com.terms: No clause on the terms page, which points to a PDF nobody could read.
uline.com.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

toolstation.com.terms: Terms not found. Robots block a bot named scraper_headless, and product pages aren't barred to others.
toolstation.com.obtained: Store's product pages, by fetch tool.

tesco.com.terms: Not read. R2 rejected it unread, and tesco.ie refuses automated requests.
tesco.com.obtained: Records quote "Tesco's listing", from the store's pages.

amazon.co.uk.terms: R2: retail pages unread. The Creators API is the allowed automated route.

amazon.com.terms: R2: retail pages unread. The Creators API is the allowed automated route.

dm.de.terms: Terms page showed no text on 7 Nov.
dm.de.obtained: Not recorded, except where a record cites Open Prices.

Auto Express.obtained: Rounded prices published in Auto Express group tests.
